witness_description: The graph with V(G)={v1,v2} and E(G)=empty set; deg(v1)=deg(v2)=0.
refutation_explanation: Having at most one edge does not imply having exactly one edge. The empty simple undirected graph on the two stated vertices has 0 edges, so E(G) is not {v1v2} and both degrees are 0 rather than 1.
search_space: All simple undirected loopless graphs on the fixed labeled vertex set {v1,v2}: the 2 subsets of the single possible edge {v1v2}, examined in mask order 0,1.
